column7: An actor replacing their OWN role set (SetUserRoles / SetProjectMemberRole, a second admin present) with roles they could grant only through a role the replacement removed: commit 1 removed the roles, commit 2 re-judged the grant ceiling and refused, the actor was left with no role at the scope and the answer was 503 MutationPartiallyApplied with retry_safe true, whose retry the pre-check refused. The ceiling is now also judged on the set commit 1 leaves, before commit 1 (requireSelfGrantCeilingAfterRemovals): refused up front, nothing written. A ceiling refusal that still reaches commit 2 (authority revoked between the commits) answers retry_safe false (PartialMutationError.RetryRefused, TestReplaceUserRoleSet_CeilingLostBetweenCommits_NotRetrySafe). HTTP: server/http TestUpdateUserRolesHTTP_SelfReplacementLosingRolesAssign_ChangesNothing.
